summary.text: Mery Lopez-Palma is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 102 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Michael Friend in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Lopez-Palma won the August 18, 2026 Republican primary with 58.1% of the vote (4,334 votes), defeating Jason Paul Smith.
She was also the Republican nominee for the same seat in 2024, when she lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Michael Gottlieb, 53.6% to 46.4%.
